title: Hausdorff measure of an affine plane spanned by an orthonormal frame is the image of Lebesgue measure
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, let w = (w_0, …, w_{m−1}) be an orthonormal family in ℝ^P (= Euclid P), a ∈ ℝ^P, and S := {y ∈ ℝ^P : y − a ∈ span(w_0, …, w_{m−1})}, the affine m-plane through a spanned by w. Let ℝ^m := Fin m → ℝ carry the product Lebesgue measure Lᵐ (volume) and j : ℝ^m → ℝ^P, j(z) := a + Σ_i z_i w_i. Then (i) the image measure j_*(Lᵐ) equals Hᵐ⌞S, where Hᵐ = μHE[m]; (ii) S is closed; (iii) (Hᵐ⌞S)(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P; (iv) (Hᵐ⌞S)(B_r(a)) > 0 for every r > 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (w : Fin m → Euclid P) (a : Euclid P), Orthonormal ℝ w → Measure.map (fun z : Fin m → ℝ => a + ∑ i, z i • w i) volume = (μHE[m] : Measure (Euclid P)).restrict {y : Euclid P | y - a ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range w)} ∧ IsClosed {y : Euclid P | y - a ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range w)} ∧ (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → ((μHE[m] : Measure (Euclid P)).restrict {y : Euclid P | y - a ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range w)}) K < ∞) ∧ ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → 0 < ((μHE[m] : Measure (Euclid P)).restrict {y : Euclid P | y - a ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range w)}) (ball a r)
